title: Review of c27's ringswim front-cut repair (SIBRM): replicated on fresh seeds 11-12, 5 of 6 cuts repair and one repaired cell swims 3.1 body lengths with its ring; wall and ring re-closure are largely automatic (curvature flow plus the coded wall-adsorption drift)
summary: Looked first at the claim's twinrepair.png (seed 6) and pack sheet, then re-ran the claimed world: labkit pack on seed 11 (rerun/, --damage 200:0.4:half) and the claim's twinrepair.py with KEEP_S=1, MODES=front, NPICK=3 on seeds 11 and 12 (tr/), tabulated with the claim's table.py and motion.py (table.txt). 6 front cuts (40% of area, 40-52% of links): 5 re-close the link ring (closure >= 0.9 at +100-140) and 4 regain pre-cut area by +360-420; the one death (seed 12 cell 39, lost at +60) had post-cut closure 0.19, matching the claim's failure rule (<= 0.26). Seed 11 cell 22 (tr/s11_keepS/twinrepair.png rows 3-4) is cut at t=10000, re-closes by +100, is back to area by +360, holds a ring >= 1.5 in every later frame and swims 3.09 body lengths from +340 to +2000 (twin 1.24). labkit's own damage follow-up on seed 11 (rerun/damage.png) shows the cut cell re-rounding and growing to 2.6-3x its post-cut area before merging with a neighbour at t~11050. The link ring holds in the rerun (radial L rim/core 1.61, rim/outside 6.57, 127/172 membrane-like).

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0 (noise over the whole domain) -> ringed cells by t~600
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: discrete walled cells throughout; tr/s11_keepS/twinrepair.png cells followed 2000 t
observations.B: rerun/FACTS.md radial L link rim/core 1.61, rim/outside 6.57 (127/172 membrane-like); bright link ring in every twinrepair crop
observations.R: table.txt: 5/6 front cuts re-close the ring at +100-140 and 4/5 regain area by +360-420 against exact branched twins (seeds 11, 12); rerun/damage.png target regrows to 2.6-3x
observations.M: table.txt seed 11 cell 22: 3.09 body lengths after repair (twin 1.24); cell 4: 2.25 (twin 3.06)

seeds_run.result: pass: 3/3 cuts repair, two swim 2.25-3.09 BL after repair
partial: 2/3 repair (one dies with closure 0.19), repaired cells swim < 0.2 BL before splitting/merging

controls_run.R: tr/s11_keepS/result.json, tr/s12_keepS/result.json: exact branched undamaged twin per cut, wound substrate kept (no fresh bath S at the wound)

verdicts.limitation: Much of the repair is automatic: the Allen-Cahn wall re-closes by curvature flow, and the links re-collect at the new wall through the coded drift chi up grad 4phi(1-phi) (the links are the cell's own product, so the ring itself counts for B). I therefore list R as observed but by construction (RUBRIC L4a: automatic repair counts for the rung and is scored under mechanism). Swimming after repair is not reliable: on seed 12 the repaired cells moved < 0.2 BL before splitting or merging, and only 2 of my 6 cuts gave >= 2 BL. labkit keeps no persistent tracks (cells merge and split; merge/split 0.76), so lifetimes rest on the twinrepair follower. Wound substrate kept only; I did not run the bath-reset variant, dt/2 or a resolution change.
